review.maintenanceAssessment: CON.40 unit C3 retires the Kotlin and Maven channel: the Gradle build (build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle.kts, gradle.properties, the gradlew wrapper, gradle/** and the root and settings lock files), the Kotlin modules under src/public/kotlin, the KotlinConnectClient consumer, the central-signing build and the Maven generation, packaging, Central and snapshot publication tooling are removed, and the three io.github.arcforges Maven rows in eng/contract-packages.json are kept and marked retired. The 96 maven: coordinates leave the admitted closure together with their lock and verification-metadata inputs, and the Gradle catalog pins (kotlin, dokka, protobuf, grpc, grpc-kotlin, coroutines, gson, connect) leave the framework selection; every remaining NuGet and npm coordinate, version, integrity value and licence is unchanged and no dependency is added. eng/provenance/records/contract-bindings-con-40-r1.json joins the bound provenance inputs. No published version is unpublished, deprecated or deleted. Independent exact-head review by the named reviewer and all required hosted CI remain mandatory before merge.

checks.compilation: dotnet build of ArcForges.Contracts.slnx and the StructureTests and ArchitectureTests runs pass locally; the C# build never depended on the removed Gradle build; pinned generation, pack and hosted Verify remain required at the reviewed head.
checks.aot-trim: No runtime library or serializer changes; the existing serialization/AOT posture and the Native AOT probe are unchanged.
checks.compatibility: No schema, descriptor or C#/TypeScript generated output changes; the compatibility window, binpb pins and reserved numbers are unaffected. Already published Maven versions stay immutable and resolvable.
checks.licence-provenance: The licence boundary drops the six removed Gradle projects; contract-bindings-con-40-r1 supersedes contract-bindings-con-25-r1 without the removed Kotlin/Java targets; the Gradle wrapper record is no longer active because its files are removed; check_provenance and check_licences pass.
checks.security-sbom: Only maven: coordinates leave the closure; the remaining locked closure, coordinates, versions, integrity values and licences are unchanged; the hosted secret scan keeps its full-history allowlist for the removed Kotlin paths.
checks.runtime-performance-migration: Removal of a retired publication channel only; the C# suites from unit C1 carry the retired Kotlin consumer cases; no runtime, migration or performance claim.
checks.framework-runtime-posture: The .NET SDK and Node pins are unchanged; the Gradle catalog pins are removed with the Kotlin toolchain, which is not a framework upgrade, so no major-upgrade review is triggered.
